# Credit Loan Risk Assessment and Interest Rate Review 2026

This document details critical actions required for the Credit & Loans department.

*   Review interest rates based on audit findings.
*   Update interest rates in alignment with the 2026 strategy.
*   Update default risk parameters for the 2026 strategy.
*   Monitor the ongoing default risk standard updates.
*   Optimize the implementation of default risk standard updates.
